rule: 0DTE ATM call at every flat open; transform at +2% into monthly ATM (all proceeds); audited part-II trail exit with R = 0.25% of transform price
transform_day_exit_convention: exit arms next day (pre-trigger low/close unusable)
description: 0DTE proof -> monthly transform -> SABM trail (the H3 pipeline): every flat day buy a 0DTE ATM call at the open (premium = the whole risk); if the underlying rises 2% intraday (editable --transform-trigger-pct), all proceeds roll into a monthly ATM call at the trigger price, ridden under the audited SABM Part-II trail (R = 0.25% of the transform price, editable) with ATM re-strikes at each monthly expiry; the exit sells at model value. r is in proof-premium multiples (-1 = the premium, the whole risk).
note: BSM-priced both legs; transform fill pessimistically AT the trigger; the exit arms from the day AFTER the transform (intraday order vs the trigger is unknowable on daily OHLC); daily proof spend = 1% of equity per attempt.
